externalSurfaceAsset.adaptation: Existing frozen repository scan, no global edits. Diffuse chroma removed and scalar luma normalized for the authored warm cedar palette. Original GL tangent normal at scale 0.30. Source roughness remapped to 0.70+0.26*source for worn exterior coating. Metric per-member UV grain orientation retained; authored anisotropic repeat 1.45m along grain and 0.38m across grain.

retainedGuides: Earlier carving135 scalar guide and generated mineral materials retain their original provenance. No reference photograph RGB or replacement frame is used by scene rendering.
limits: Single-view metric and hidden joints are reconstruction hypotheses, not a structural engineering certification.
Overlapping separate solid timber members form authored joints; this is not a global Boolean-union model.
Native render validity does not establish photographic fidelity.
